Record Class ClientRegistrationController.RegistrationRequest

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
com.leap.leaplaughlove.iam.client.ClientRegistrationController.RegistrationRequest
Record Components:
email - applicant email address
phone - applicant phone number
fullName - applicant full name
dateOfBirth - applicant date of birth (must be at least 21)
ssn - applicant Social Security Number in XXX-XX-XXXX format
addressLine1 - primary address line
addressLine2 - secondary address line (optional)
city - address city
stateRegion - address state or region
postalCode - address postal code
countryCode - two-letter ISO country code
experienceLevel - investment experience level (NOVICE, INTERMEDIATE, ADVANCED)
initialDepositAmount - initial deposit amount (minimum 5000.00)
password - the applicant's chosen sign-in password (must be at least 8 characters)
Enclosing class:
ClientRegistrationController
public static record ClientRegistrationController.RegistrationRequest(@NotBlank @Email String email, String phone, @NotBlank String fullName, @NotNull LocalDate dateOfBirth, @NotBlank @Pattern(regexp="\\d{3}-\\d{2}-\\d{4}",message="ssn must be in format XXX-XX-XXXX") String ssn, @NotBlank String addressLine1, String addressLine2, @NotBlank String city, String stateRegion, @NotBlank String postalCode, @NotBlank @Size(min=2,max=2) String countryCode, @NotBlank @Pattern(regexp="NOVICE|INTERMEDIATE|ADVANCED") String experienceLevel, @NotNull @DecimalMin("5000.00") BigDecimal initialDepositAmount, @NotBlank @Size(min=8,message="password must be at least 8 characters") String password) extends Record
Represents the client registration request containing all necessary client details for registering a new client in the IAM system.
